hmmmm....
I suggest you look at the gain in the "middle" of the BBD vs. measuring at the start/end, to measure aspects that are inherent to the BBD itself vs. having to think about (de) embedding the harness.
Also as I mentioned maybe try to use poly2 with 3 phases for an actual CCD structure vs. this?
You can calculate the numbers to put into the SPICE model btw; you need to specify channel width/length and source and drain area and perimeter; there are forumulas in xschem that try to calculate you typical source/drain area/perimeter values from finger count and sizing; note that due to overlap, the intermediate devices can be simulated with only half the area and perimeter specified because one's drain is the next one's source.
